edges.reason: msg.sender flows into mint as the minter, the refund recipient and, via _mint, the safe-mint recipient.
msg.sender is hashed into the pseudo-random token selection, making it caller-influenceable.
block.timestamp is part of the randomness hash, creating miner-manipulable timestamp dependency.
isSaleOn gates the mint entry point.
_price is read to compute the required payment in mint.
_price is read by getCostForMintingPunks to compute cost.
setPrice writes the owner-controlled _price state variable.
MAX_MINTABLE_AT_ONCE caps the loop size in _mint.
_numAvailableTokens is read and written back by the _mint loop.
_numAvailableTokens is used as the modulus for the random index.
_availableTokens is read and mutated by useAvailableTokenAtIndex.
oaf address receives the team share via send.
quack address receives the remaining balance via send.
_baseTokenURI is concatenated into the returned tokenURI.
msg.sender is the destination of the overpayment refund transfer in mint.
withdrawFailsafe sends the whole balance to msg.sender through a low-level call.
mint invokes the internal _mint function.
mint executes the external refund transfer to msg.sender.
_mint calls useRandomAvailableToken on each loop iteration.
useRandomAvailableToken calls useAvailableTokenAtIndex with the derived index.
_safeMint inside _mint invokes onERC721Received on contract recipients before state finalisation.
Officialcasting safe-mints tokens, triggering the ERC721 receiver callback.
withdrawTeam performs the oaf send.
withdrawTeam performs the quack send.
withdrawFailsafe performs the low-level value call to msg.sender.
msg.sender is checked against the owner by the onlyOwner modifier on withdrawTeam.
msg.sender is checked against the owner by the onlyOwner modifier on withdrawFailsafe.
msg.sender is checked against the owner by the onlyOwner modifier on Officialcasting.

normalization_plan.reason: User-supplied quantity is fully consumed by the mint function's cost, supply and loop logic.
Internal quantity parameter only drives the _mint loop bound.
Parameter is only hashed into the randomness derivation of useRandomAvailableToken.
Loop index parameter exists solely for the randomness hash in useRandomAvailableToken.
Index parameter is the sole input of the swap-and-pop removal logic.
New price parameter is directly assigned to _price in setPrice.
Parameter is used only to compute the returned cost value.
Parameter is assigned directly to punkcontractURI.
Parameter is assigned directly to imageHash.
Local cache of total supply used only inside mint's supply check.
Local computed cost used only for mint's payment and refund logic.
Local accumulator written back to _numAvailableTokens at the end of _mint.
Local random token id consumed by the _safeMint call in _mint.
Local hash output used only to derive the index within useRandomAvailableToken.
Local modulo result passed straight into useAvailableTokenAtIndex.
